name: Thomas Pfuhler
headline: Leader BCG Financial Institutions Practice Europe, Middle East, South America, Africa
summary:
I am a MD & Senior Partner with Boston Consulting Group, leading BCG’s Financial Institutions (FI) Practice for Europe, Middle East, South America, Africa and serving on the Global Leadership Team of BCG‘s FI Practice. 

I have served on the Global Leadership Team of BCG's Risk & Compliance Practice leading the business lines Risk Management and Risk & Compliance in Payments.

I bring ca. 20yrs experience working for the leading incumbent & new players in the Financial and Payments Sector (i) in large scale transformation programs incl. Effectiveness, Risk & Regulatory Remediation and AI & Tech Programs and (ii) working across all dimensions of Risk & Compliance strategies, operating models and business enablement.

Specifically, I have deep expertise in
- designing AI control frameworks
- PMIs, Risk & Regulation Programs, Legal Entity Management (LEM)
- Recovery & Resolution Planning (RRP) programs and Non-Core Unit Management
- Effectiveness & efficiency programs across all dimensions of an Risk operating model (incl. Tech & Data).

Before my professional and academic career I was a professional soccer player in the youth teams of FC Bayern Munich, which was a decisive time for shaping my "helping a team win" mindest. It also taught me the lesson that success and achievement come from overcoming adversity and that team accomplishment far exceeds anyone's individual goals.

company.name: Boston Consulting Group (BCG)
company.description:
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we work closely with clients to embrace a transformational approach aimed at benefiting all stakeholders—empowering organizations to grow, build sustainable competitive advantage, and drive positive societal impact.
 
Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives that question the status quo and spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting, technology and design, and corporate and digital ventures. 

We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, fueled by the goal of helping our clients thrive and enabling them to make the world a better place.
